incident.acceptance_step: eval-suite development baseline (not an acceptance step)

stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: checkout error spans in the last 5 minutes: traces_span_metrics_calls_total increase over 300s for service_name=checkout = 5 for STATUS_CODE_ERROR vs 17.5 for STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Within the last 5 minutes, checkout's error spans are limited to span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (increase 2.5) and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (2.5); oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct all read 0 for STATUS_CODE_ERROR.
payment shows its own error spans in the same 5-minute window: service_name=payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 2.5 vs STATUS_CODE_UNSET 3.75.

Trace e9bdeb5e0493b9bcccdb83ab26c6feee shows checkout span a1c52a8ba9339504 (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 36561 us) with error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 and otel.status_description "failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold"; its child checkout span 94a4f7f102d50565 (oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=2, and the payment-service server span 156767a96cb97162 (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, 14349 us) is ERROR with stacktrace "module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)".

Trace 7e5d7a0badee03bd22c986680ca341d5 repeats the same pattern: checkout span 62aa19430aeaaa3a (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 27336 us) ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, checkout client span 7a16dc5829695df3 (oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) ERROR grpc status 2, and payment span e82ba085c0ec508c (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) ERROR with the same "Payment request failed. Invalid token." message.

The same two traces show HTTP 500 error spans outside checkout: frontend span 5388c7e167eea04b (POST /api/checkout, http.status_code 500) and 9269814c9926dad9 (executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, exception "13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... Payment request failed. Invalid token."), frontend-proxy spans 0cf6011deb94ca58 (ingress) and 61231243ddeb1186 (router frontend egress) with http.status_code 500, and load-generator span 32095e5bee164599 (POST) with http.status_code 500.

Over the past hour (14:53:30Z–15:53:30Z) the error share is large: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder has STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 38.64 vs STATUS_CODE_UNSET 56.94, checkout client oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 36.60 vs 56.94, and payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 36.60 vs 56.94 (span counts, not request counts).

Five-minute buckets of STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans from 14:53:30Z–15:53:30Z show checkout errors in most buckets (14:58:30 1.25, 15:03:30 2.33, 15:08:30 2.51, 15:23:30 2.5, 15:28:30 12.5, 15:38:30 25.0, 15:43:30 15.0, 15:48:30 2.5, 15:53:30 5.0) with payment errors following the same buckets (0,0,0,1.25,6.25,0,12.5,7.5,1.25,2.5), i.e. errors are present in and before the last 5 minutes.

In the earlier hour 08:53:30Z–09:53:30Z both services were error-free: checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 0 vs 1120.68 UNSET, payment STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 vs 170.85 UNSET, so the current error condition is recent relative to that baseline.

checkout's other dependencies show no error spans in the last 5 minutes: cart STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 (UNSET 80), product-catalog STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 (UNSET 116.25), currency only STATUS_CODE_OK 6.25, shipping only STATUS_CODE_UNSET 5, email STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0; matching trace spans (cart oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, checkout client oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote) all carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and currency server spans carry otel.status_code=OK.

product-catalog did have a small error burst earlier in the hour (STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase per 5-min bucket 5.41 at 15:03:30, 5.01 at 15:08:30, 3.77 at 15:13:30, 3.75 at 15:18:30) and 0 in every bucket from 15:23:30 onward including the last 5 minutes; cart shows a single 1.25 value at 14:58:30 and 0 thereafter.

checkout client RPC mean durations in the last 5 minutes vs the 14:48:30Z–14:53:30Z window: Charge 13.37 ms vs 10.76 ms, GetQuote 8.76 ms vs 8.63 ms, GetCart 1.98 ms vs 2.25 ms, Convert 1.83 ms vs 1.70 ms, GetProduct 0.55 ms vs 0.65 ms (EmptyCart NaN in the current window vs 39532 ms one hour earlier; ShipOrder NaN vs 0.63 ms).

Whole-service mean span durations in the last 5 minutes: checkout 8.75 ms, payment 8.76 ms, shipping 7.13 ms, cart 1.19 ms, currency 0.78 ms, product-catalog 0.30 ms, email NaN (no data); in the clean hour 08:53:30Z–09:53:30Z they were checkout 8.64 ms, payment 1.87 ms, shipping 3.09 ms, cart 0.98 ms, currency 0.72 ms, product-catalog 0.21 ms, email 5.65 ms.

email issued no spans in the last 5 minutes (increase 0 for span_name POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email and sinatra.render_template) whereas over the past hour those span names read 56.94, 56.94 and 113.88; no email span with STATUS_CODE_ERROR was returned.

One sampled span from a third trace, e61e1410fd25ce0529359547543d418a, is a checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems span (span_id dbd1e3c3fcde8666, 50000 us) with error=true and exception.message "rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = upstream response deadline exceeded while preparing order items (request id req-u1wgjdhf)"; it has no parent_references, so its upstream is not visible.

Deepest supported cause: the payment service's Charge handler rejects charges with an application error ("Payment request failed. Invalid token.", thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) and returns gRPC code Unknown(2); checkout wraps this as INTERNAL(13) on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, which surfaces as HTTP 500 in frontend/frontend-proxy and load-generator. payment's own evaluation call grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat to flagd returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in the failing trace, so the token rejection itself is not accompanied by an observed transport failure to flagd.

Secondary candidate: a distinct failure mode exists on checkout span oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems (DeadlineExceeded, trace e61e1410fd25ce0529359547543d418a). It is not corroborated by the aggregate signal — prepareOrderItems STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase is 0 in both the last-5-minute and the past-hour windows — and no parent reference is visible, so no dependency can be attributed to it.

Payment's whole-service mean span duration is higher in the last 5 minutes (8.76 ms) than in the two comparison windows (2.17 ms at 14:48:30Z–14:53:30Z and 1.87 ms at 08:53:30Z–09:53:30Z); because the failing Charge spans also include a flagd ResolveFloat child (~10.9 ms in the sample) the difference may reflect span-mix change on the error path rather than degraded latency, and it is a single-digit-millisecond difference, so latency degradation is not established.

Elevated dependency latency or timeouts as the cause of the checkout errors is rejected: the failing PlaceOrder spans complete in 27–37 ms with explicit application messages ("Payment request failed. Invalid token.", grpc code Unknown), payment Charge client spans take 9–17 ms, and checkout client RPC means are close to the one-hour baseline (Charge 13.37 ms vs 10.76 ms; GetQuote 8.76 ms vs 8.63 ms; GetCart 1.98 ms vs 2.25 ms).

cart or product-catalog failure as the cause of the last-5-minute checkout errors is rejected: both read STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0 in the window and their trace spans carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and product-catalog's small error burst ended at ~15:18:30, before the window.

gaps: No kube-state, pod-log or change-history integration is available in this Run (kubernetes_state, pod_logs, change_history are not_integrated), so no deployment, restart, configuration or feature-flag change can be confirmed or dated; the flag content served by flagd to payment is unknown even though the flagd evaluation span itself returned grpc status 0.

Request-level error rate is not derivable: traces_span_metrics_calls_total counts spans of every operation, and traces_search returned a biased sample (3 checkout traces, 2 payment traces in the last 5 minutes), so the complete call chain and true request failure ratio are unknown.

No STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for currency, shipping or email, so their error status is unknown rather than zero; email additionally had no spans at all in the last 5 minutes, so its current health could not be assessed.

The single DeadlineExceeded span (trace e61e1410fd25ce0529359547543d418a) has no parent reference and no matching aggregate error increase, so the upstream that exceeded its deadline cannot be identified from this evidence.

The 14:48:30Z–14:53:30Z comparison window contained much larger span durations (checkout mean 6922 ms, cart 1816 ms, EmptyCart 39532 ms) whose cause was not investigated; latency comparison across that window may be distorted by those outliers.
next_steps: Inspect the payment service source at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37 and the payment token-validation/feature-flag configuration to determine why charges are rejected with "Invalid token" during the incident window.
Review payment and checkout configuration/change history and the flagd flag definitions (via a change-history integration) to determine when and by whom the payment failure behaviour was introduced.
Collect payment pod logs for the failing request ids to confirm the token-rejection path and check for any additional failure modes alongside it.

Follow up on the isolated prepareOrderItems DeadlineExceeded (trace e61e1410fd25ce0529359547543d418a) by capturing unsampled traces with parent references to identify the upstream dependency involved.
report_parsed.summary: In the last 5 minutes (2026-11-03T15:48:30Z–15:53:30Z) checkout shows elevated error spans (STATUS_CODE_ERROR increase 5, alongside STATUS_CODE_UNSET 17.5), and the errors are concentrated on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and its client call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; all other checkout client error series (EmptyCart, prepareOrderItems, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct) read 0 in that window. Traces tie the failures to the payment service: traces e9bdeb5e0493b9bcccdb83ab26c6feee and 7e5d7a0badee03bd22c986680ca341d5 show checkout PlaceOrder failing with gRPC INTERNAL 13 "failed to charge card ... rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold", and the payment-service server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge in the same traces carries an ERROR status with a stacktrace at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13). Payment has its own error spans in the window (ERROR 2.5 vs UNSET 3.75) and over the past hour roughly 40% of Charge/PlaceOrder spans carried ERROR status (ERROR 38.64 vs UNSET 56.94), while the same services had 0 error spans in the 08:53:30–09:53:30 hour — so this is a recent, ongoing error condition, not latency-driven. Latency in the window is low (call durations of ~0.07–37 ms; checkout client Charge mean 13.37 ms vs 10.76 ms an hour earlier), so no elevated-latency signal is supported. cart, product-catalog, currency and shipping show no error spans in the last 5 minutes; product-catalog had a small error burst between ~15:03 and ~15:18 that ended before the window. email issued no spans in the last 5 minutes (consistent with no successful order confirmations) and has no ERROR-status series, so its health is unknown rather than proven good. One sampled span (trace e61e1410fd25ce0529359547543d418a) carries a DeadlineExceeded on checkout prepareOrderItems with no visible parent, and remains an unresolved secondary candidate.
